input.free_text_description: The system operates in the authentication, user management domain. It serves API Consumer, User as its primary actors. The main business capabilities include global exception handler, user, my user details. Core business data revolves around AppUser. The system enforces access control and identity verification for protected operations.

user_stories.story: As a API Consumer, I want to manage user accounts and profiles, so that user information stays current and accurate.
As a API Consumer, I want to manage global exception handler operations, so that the relevant business process is handled efficiently.
As a API Consumer, I want to interact with my user details functionality, so that the system fulfills my needs.
